name: Play Integrity
author: AndroUnderTheHood
description: Installs and configures Tricky Store (OSS / original / TEESimulator), Play Integrity Fork or PIF [INJECT] and a Zygisk provider on Magisk, Kitsune, KernelSU or APatch. Downloads official GitHub releases (SHA-256 checked), manages target.txt, security patch and your keybox (with Google revocation check), generates a fingerprint and checks the verdict.
